_comment: ADT price table (ADT-115). Anthropic list rates, USD per million tokens.
Cache rates are NOT stored: they are DERIVED from base input via the
multipliers below, exactly as the pricing docs define them. Storing five
numbers per model would be five chances to get one wrong.
Keyed by model AND speed: fast mode rebases the whole table, and the
caching multipliers stack on top of fast-mode pricing.
Bump `version` on any rate change — a stamped cost records which version
priced it, so a correction is auditable instead of silently rewriting
